title: Shuan Zung Ming Not Listed

page_data.en:
File No.D.4901.
________

▲ Chinese named Shuan Zung Ming(單成明)
was arrested at the corner of Ward and Dalny Roads
at 8.10 a.m. May 19. He was found in possession
of "Red" literature, of which a list is attached.
Mr. Ma Chao Woo(馬紹武) claimed him as an agent
and stated that the Literature had been collected
on his behalf. He, however, failed to give a
satisfactory explanation regarding the source of
the literature. The variety and quantity of the
literature indicated that the person, in whose
possession was found, must enjoy the confidence
of the Communist Party in a measure which could
only be gained by "Red" work.
page_data.zh:
档案编号 D.4901。
________

▲ 华人单成明（Shuan Zung Ming）于5月19日上午8时10分在华德路（Ward Road）与大连路（Dalny Road）转角处被捕。搜查发现其持有“红色”文献，清单附后。马绍武（Ma Chao Woo）先生认领其为代理人，并称这些文献是代其收集的。然而，他未能就文献来源给出令人满意的解释。文献的种类和数量表明，被查获持有这些文献的人必定在一定程度上获得了共产党的信任，而这种信任只有通过从事“红色”工作才能取得。

List of communist literature seized from an unnumbered
house on Yulin Road near Fenchow Road, the home of the
accused, Shuan Zung Ming, who was arrested on May 19 on
Ward Road near Dalny Road.

1) Handbill addressed to the workers of the British
American Tobacco Company urging them to protest
against the 3-day shift and to support the Chinese
Communist Youth League, purporting to emanate from
the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Chinese
Communist Youth League dated May 15. 80 copies

2) Handbill addressed to the workers of the British
American Tobacco Company urging them to extend
the strike and to overthrow the Yellow Labour
Union, purporting to emanate from the Young
Workers Department of the Old Labour Union dated
May 15. 35 "

3) Handbill dated May 14 purporting to emanate from
the Yangtsepoo District Committee of the Chinese
Communist Youth League, addressed to the young
workers of the British American Tobacco Company
urging them to demand $3 rice allowance, to protest
against arrest and dismissal and to support the
Chinese Communist Youth League. 100 "

4) Handbill entitled "Strike News" urging the
workers to besiege the Public Safety Bureau. 120 "

5) Slip of paper containing the slogan: "Oppose
the dismissal of a worker". 40 "

6) Slip of paper containing the slogan: "Demand
an increase of 5-cents". 20 "

7) Slip of paper containing the slogan: "Oppose
5-day shift and 6-day shift". 50 "
page_data.zh:
从榆林路（Yulin Road）近汾州路（Fenchow Road）一处无门牌号的房屋中搜获的共产主义文献清单，该处为被告单成明（Shuan Zung Ming）的住所，单于5月19日在华德路近大连路被捕。

1) 小标语致英美烟草公司工人，号召他们抗议三班倒工作制并支持中国共产主义青年团，声称出自中国共产主义青年团江苏省委，日期5月15日。80份

2) 小标语致英美烟草公司工人，号召他们扩大罢工并推翻黄色工会，声称出自旧工会青年工人部，日期5月15日。35份

3) 小标语日期5月14日，声称出自中国共产主义青年团杨树浦区委员会，致英美烟草公司青年工人，号召他们要求3元米贴，抗议逮捕和解雇，并支持中国共产主义青年团。100份

4) 小标语题为《罢工消息》，号召工人包围公安局。120份

5) 纸条包含口号：“反对开除工人”。40份

6) 纸条包含口号：“要求增加五分钱”。20份

7) 纸条包含口号：“反对五天班和六天班”。50份
